parsed.rationale: Both `MockQualityClock` (Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/AdaptiveQualityControllerTests.swift:19) and `MockClock` (Shared/Caching/Tests/CachingTests/CacheCoordinatorTests.swift:41) are `type-alias-object` declarations living inside per-package test directories for unrelated packages (`Wallpaper` and `Caching`). Their structural identity (shared_field_count: 2) is coincidental: each alias exists to satisfy a local test fixture's clock-protocol conformance, and the two packages have no reason to share a common mock-clock definition. Extracting a shared alias would introduce an artificial cross-package test-support dependency between `Wallpaper` and `Caching`, coupling unrelated domains for no semantic gain.
